==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Tianhe:''' It seems like my leg really doesn't hurt anymore...
:'''Tianhe:''' Huh? I'm sorry, is there anything I can help you with?
:{{DIcon}} Are you injured?
:'''Tianhe:''' Uh... Yes, the [[Tacet Discord]] in [[Norfall Barrens]] is active and the attacks are intense. It's inevitable to get injured.
:'''Tianhe:''' Last week, we, the defenders, successfully repelled ten attacks from the Tacet Discord. It's already good that I only have these minor injuries.
:'''Tianhe:''' But luckily, General [[Jiyan]] is here. That's why I was able to recover from my injuries so quickly.",
:{{DIcon}} Jiyan?
:'''Tianhe:''' Yes, that day he noticed that my legs seemed a bit strange after standing for a long time, and he quickly brought me ointment.
:'''Tianhe:''' I don't know how he could see the symptoms at a glance, and I didn't expect him to pay attention to such small details...
:'''Tianhe:''' He took the time to personally deliver the medicine and told me how to take care of myself. Look, I'm already jumping around now. It's amazing, isn't it?!
:'''Tianhe:''' Hehe, I didn't expect him to be such a caring person.
{{Dialogue End}}
